title: Ethan Chen
text:
This is a Quarto website.
About me I was born in Taiwan and I moved to Vancouver when I was 10 years old. I did my highschool in Vancouver and I went to U of Waterloo for my undergraduate degree in software engineering. I have mostly worked as a full-stack development intern in multiple companies. By joining MDSCL, I hope to gain relevant technical skills, make valuable connections, and advance my career.

Why Data Science
I did mostly full-stack web development for my co-ops during undergrad, and I wanted to pivot into more data analysis jobs. I am also interested in learning about the base concepts behind AI and machine learning. In addition, I am intrigued by the linguistics courses and its applications in AI.
